login.title: Sign in · 1lev1
login.heading: Good to see you again
login.subtitle: Email and password, and you are back in.
login.forgotPassword: if lost password please press me
login.emailConfirmed: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in.

confirm.spentBody: A confirmation link works only once, and mail apps sometimes open it by themselves before you get to click. If that happened, your account is already confirmed - just sign in with the email and password you chose.
confirm.missingBody: This address arrived without a confirmation code. If you came from an email, open the link again from the original message.
confirm.errorTitle: Something went wrong on our side
confirm.errorBody: We couldn't check the link right now. Please try again in a moment, and if it keeps happening write to us at baruch@1lev1.com
confirm.resent: ✓ If confirmation is still needed, a new link is on its way
confirm.emailPlaceholder: The email you signed up with
confirm.help: Still stuck? Write to us at baruch@1lev1.com

reset.title: Reset password · 1💗1
reset.heading: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Enter the email address you registered with and we'll send you a reset link
reset.successTitle: The email is on its way
reset.successBody: A password reset link was sent to your email. Can't see it? Check your spam folder too.
reset.error: We couldn't send the email. Please try again, and if it keeps happening write to us at baruch@1lev1.com

change.title: Create new password · 1💗1
change.heading: Create a new password
change.subtitle: Pick a strong password and rest easy
change.successBody: You can now log in with your new password
change.error: We couldn't update the password. The link may have expired - you can request a new one from the reset page.

expired.title: Your session has expired
expired.body: It's been a while since your last visit, so your sign-in expired. Signing in again brings you right back to where you were.

errorScreen.authBody: We couldn't identify you. If it's been a while since your last visit, your sign-in has probably expired - signing in again brings you right back to the page you wanted.
errorScreen.serverTitle: Something went wrong on our side
errorScreen.maybeSession: If you haven't signed in here for a long time, an expired session may be all this is - it's worth signing in again.
